verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail clearly bundles lease-grade (TruLease) and residency-grade (TruResidence) addresses alongside mail service and a free registered agent, all from one provider, and even markets choosing between them for compliance needs. However, 'LLC formation' is only represented by TruStart's self-paced educational videos and registered-agent-change templates, not an actual entity-formation/filing service. Missing for 10: evidence of an actual LLC formation/filing product (not just educational videos), and independent confirmation these entity services integrate seamlessly as a single workflow.
